question: Which country hosted the first ever Commonwealth Games in 1930?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Canada__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Commonwealth Games:

 
 
• Commonwealth Games were previously called the 'British Empire Game'.
 
• The Commonwealth Games take place every four years.
 
• The first Commonwealth Games were held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada.
 
• The last country to join the Commonwealth was Rwanda in 2009.
 
• UK, Birmingham is to host the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Olympic Games:

 
 
• The first modern Olympics were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896.
 
• The Olympic Games were held every four years.
 
• **Paris **is to host the **2024 Olympics.**
 
 
 
• Asian Games:
 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad.
 
• The Asian Games is a multi-disciplinary sports event held once every four years.
 
• It is the second-largest multi-sport event after the Olympics.
 
• It is held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The first-ever Asian Games were held at New Delhi in 1951.
 
• China is to host the 2022 Asian Games.
 
 
 
• Pan American Games:
 
 
• It is an American summer sports event.
 
• The competition is held among athletes from nations of the Americas.
 
• It is held every four years.
